pages.title: Arcane Tools
pages.text: A diamond tool, infused, learns to reach further than its edge.$(br2)The $(l)Arcane Pickaxe$() and $(l)Arcane Shovel$() dig a 3x3 square. The $(l)Arcane Axe$() fells a whole tree in one swing.$(br2)Each extra block costs $(l)1 mana$(). $(l)Sneak$() to dig a single block for free.

pages.name: Tool Infusion
pages.text: The same pattern for all three tools. Offer the diamond tool, with $(l)100 mana$().

pages.title: Notes
pages.text: $(li)Enchantments are not carried over. Infuse a plain tool and enchant it afterwards.$(li)The pickaxe won't break blocks much harder than the one you hit, so no free obsidian.$(li)Chests, furnaces and other storage are never caught in the square.$(li)The axe only fells logs that touch natural leaves, so your log cabin is safe.$(li)Repair them with $(l)Mana Crystals$().
Diamond-strength, and more durable than diamond.
